notes: Pinned to the same MiniMax-M3 freecode runs, through MiniMax's Anthropic-compatible endpoint, on the same key — the 'one bill' property of spec §5. CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW is a FAIRNESS correction, not a tuning knob: the /anthropic shim reports a 200K context window for M3 instead of its real 1M (MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-M2.7#46), so Claude Code would auto-compact at ~167K while freecode reads models.dev's true 1048576. The value here IS that number, not a round one. Leaving it unset would hand us a win we did not earn. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is cleared because an operator's shell export would otherwise silently redirect the run to Anthropic and bill it elsewhere. Verified against claude 2.1.251.
